metadata.name: Sarah - The Nosy Neighbor
metadata.author: Example Modder
metadata.description: Adds Sarah, a curious neighbor who sometimes visits the family. Can be befriended or becomes suspicious of unusual family dynamics.

character_data.name: Sarah
character_data.background: Sarah has lived next door for 5 years. She's a stay-at-home mom with too much free time, leading her to take an keen interest in the neighborhood's affairs. She means well but can be intrusive.

custom_dialogue.greeting: Oh hi! I was just in the neighborhood... thought I'd stop by!
custom_dialogue.high_rapport: You know, you're one of the few people I can really talk to around here.
custom_dialogue.high_suspicion: Is everything... okay with the family? You all seem... different lately.
custom_dialogue.low_rapport: I should probably get going. Lots to do today.
custom_dialogue.phs_vulnerable: You always give such good advice. I don't know what I'd do without you.
custom_dialogue.phs_resistant: That's sweet, but I think I'll figure this out on my own.
